title: ux-recast lesson front matter
description: The front matter of a lesson file: a Markdown file whose first block holds one `key: <JSON value>` line per field. A project lesson lives in .ux-recast/lessons/project/; promotion copies it to the shared tier. A rejected or superseded lesson is kept, never deleted, and records why (concept C-59).

identity.description: The originating project: normalized origin remote, '#', root commit hash.

links.description: What the lesson rests on, by name (finding, diff, before, after, test, outcome): project-relative paths, optionally with a #fragment.

supported_by.description: Outcomes that support the lesson, each from a project identity computed when the support was added.

reason.description: Why the lesson was rejected or superseded.

superseded_by.description: The lesson that replaces a superseded one, when there is one.

promoted_by_instruction.description: The user's explicit instruction, when a lesson was promoted without a second project's support.
